senses.gloss:
अट् cl. 1. P. Ā. अटति, ˚ते, आट, अटिष्यति, आटीत्, अटितुम्, to roam, wander about (sometimes with acc.; frequently used of religious mendicants) :
Intens. अटाट्यते, to roam or wander about zealously or habitually, especially as a religious mendicant:
Desid. अटिटिषति, to be desirous of roaming.
आट् ind. a croak (imitation of the sound uttered by a frog), TāṇḍyaBr.
